item.title: Lawn Sign
item.description: Lightweight, durable, and weather-resistant corrugated plastic signs ideal for indoor and outdoor use. A cost-effective choice for real estate, political, yard, event, construction, and promotional signage. Available in 4mm thickness and with/out step stakes. Suitable for up to 12–18 months outdoors and 2+ years indoors.

item.title: Palm Card
item.description: Palm Cards are the workhorse of grassroots outreach. Compact, easy to carry and built for face-to-face moments. Slip a stack in your pocket, bag or clipboard and you're ready for canvassing, tabling, events or handshake-and-go conversations. Sized to hand off in seconds without breaking stride, the small format forces clarity: your key point, front and center. These are perfect for campaign walk pieces, event promos, business intros, labor organizations, nonprofit outreach or quick-reference.

item.title: Greeting Card
item.description: Say it with style using a Greeting Card, since some moments deserve more than a text message. Inside, you'll find plenty of blank space to write a heartfelt note in your own words. Comes complete with a matching envelope, ready to seal, stamp, and send.

item.title: Raffle Ticket
item.description: Make your next fundraiser, giveaway or event unforgettable with our premium raffle tickets. Perfect for schools, nonprofits, sports teams, churches and community events, these tickets are designed to keep your raffle organized, professional, and easy to run from start to finish! Tickets are printed on durable cardstock and come sequentially numbered for accurate tracking and easy winner selection. They are fully customizable with your event name, date, logo or prize details, with a perforated design to separate participant and entry portions.

item.title: Presentation Folder
item.description: Make a lasting first impression with our professional presentation folders, designed to keep your materials organized and your brand front and center. Each folder features two spacious interior pockets, perfect for holding brochures, proposals, contracts, spec sheets, or any loose documents you need to present in a polished, cohesive package. Built for practicality, each pocket has an option to include a die-cut slit, specifically sized for business cards, so your contact information stays neatly in place. It's a small detail that makes a big difference when a client or prospect reaches for your card after a meeting.
item.g:google_product_category: Business & Industrial > Office Supplies > Presentation Supplies > Business Folders

item.title: Certified Mailing Package
item.description: Send it once. Prove it forever. When it absolutely, positively has to be documented, Certified Letters give you peace of mind that your important correspondence was sent, received, and legally verifiable. Whether you're sending a legal notice, formal business communication, landlord-tenant notice or any correspondence where proof of delivery matters, our Certified Letter service covers everything, taking the guesswork (and the post office line) out of the equation.

item.title: Simple Mailing Package
item.description: Send Real Mail, Hassle-Free. Some things deserve more than a text. Our mailing packages make it easy to send a personal letter, business letter or postcard to the people who matter. No stamps. No trips to the post office. No guessing at postage. Every mailing package includes your choice of one or two pages, color or black & white, design services and quantity. Postage is fully included! Send us your own mailing list and design, or let us handle it for you. It is that easy – we process, print, seal and mail. You spend that extra time doing something you actually enjoy!
